title: Rollback Approval Revocation record
description: Phase 149L implementation of RAE-001 v1.0 Sec.15 (RAE-REQ-046). A rollback_approval_revocation document is a new, immutable, append-only record marking a Rollback Approval Binding as revoked -- never an in-place edit of the original Binding file (RAE-REQ-057's immutability discipline, restated for the Binding layer). Its mere existence at `revocations/<evidence_id>.json`, addressed by the same evidence_id as the Binding it revokes, is what the Evidence Validator checks; this schema governs only its own shape.

record_type.description: Always present. Fixed, dedicated family tag -- independent of any TAM record_family value.

revoked_by.description: Always present. The principal who revoked this Binding; may differ from the original issuing principal (RAE-REQ-046).
